label: Checkmark list
description: A ruled list with an accent checkmark opening each row — the handoff's inline "spec table" for what a service covers or what a customer gets. A row may lead with a bold title, set on its own line above the text. A real <ul>, so each row is one item the dealer edits, adds or reorders.

options.label: ✕ In a red badge, titled rows
✕ In an ink badge, titled rows
✓ In a small ink badge, compact titled rows

html:
{{#each items}}
  • {{#if title}}{{title}}{{/if}}{{text}}
    • {{/each}}
